title: Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A flavorful, aromatic dish with a rich history, blending Tunisian and German flavors in a traditional tagine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sear the lamb pieces until browned, then set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the aromatic spice blend and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the seared lamb, crushed tomatoes, chicken broth, and preserved dates.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer the tagine to the oven.
Bake at 160°C for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove from the oven and stir in the honey, if using.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs or a side of couscous.
